A tax equal to the top marginal rate on individuals under this article on the West Virginia taxable income of an electing pass-through entity that makes the election provided under this section, is hereby annually imposed.

notes:
West Virginia has no recurring franchise-type levy on a default LLC: applies is false, resting on the State Tax Department's own documents. The business registration tax of W. Va. Code § 11-12-3 is a $30 charge per business registration certificate, but the certificate is permanent - Special Notice 10-01 (2010) abolished renewal ('the renewal of the business registration certificate will no longer be necessary'), the Division's Business Registration page says the certificate is permanent until the business's name, location or ownership changes, and the June 2025 Business Registration Information & Instructions answer 'How long is my business registration certificate valid?' with 'The Business Registration Certificate is permanent.' The $30 is therefore a one-time (or per-change) registration charge, not a recurring annual levy, and it fails the inclusion test. The article literally captioned Business Franchise Tax is the copied-table trap: § 11-23-6(b)(11) says no tax is due for taxable years beginning on or after 2015. The general Business and Occupation Tax rates were repealed in 1989 (§ 11-13-2a, -2b); the B&O sections that remain are utility and power-industry rates. The corporate license tax (article 12C) and the corporation net income tax (article 24) are corporation-only, and a default LLC's only annual state obligations are its income-tax filings and the Secretary of State's annual report.
collectedWithAnnualReport is null: no franchise-type levy exists for a default LLC, and root states.json carries annual_report_fee 25 for West Virginia, the Secretary of State's annual report fee, a separate payment with no tax to overlap.
stateIncomeTax: members owe West Virginia personal income tax on their pass-through shares - § 11-21-3(b) taxes owners only in their separate or individual capacities unless the entity elects otherwise. The top marginal rate is 4.58% for taxable years beginning on or after January 1, 2026 (§ 11-21-4j; the 2025 rate was 4.82% under § 11-21-4i). West Virginia offers the Elective Pass Through Entity Tax created by SB 151 (2023) - § 11-21-3a: a pass-through entity may elect, annually and irrevocably for the year, to pay a tax equal to the top individual marginal rate directly on the entity's income (residents' income plus apportioned nonresidents'), with owners receiving the EK-1 credit; for calendar-year entities the election is due on or before March 15 (the Division's EPT page).
